verdicts.note: Refers to herself as 'a girl' (line 923) and woman in engineering throughout; clearly female.
States she started placement on 3rd August, six-month placement; yes is correct.
Values variety ('jump from here to there') but quote is transport-vs-structural, weakly tied to choosing engineering because varied; downgrade to low.
Frames placement as good work experience of the real world; agree is supported.
'know what the real world is' maps onto seeing what industry is really like; agree supported.
'more competitive when you graduate' and 'contacts with companies' directly support improving job chances.
Placement helping decide whether to stay/work in England; agree fits, medium fair.
Genuinely undecided ('not sure if I will stick with engineering'); don't know is best fit.
Quote only shows she moved AWAY from managerial; no positive endorsement of technical/specialist, and she is pervasively uncertain, so 'don't know' is better supported than 2.
Salary repeatedly stressed as decisive ('I need to talk about money now!', 'only drawback is the salary'); very important supported.
Plans to move country to country and cites travel as why she chose engineering; important supported.
Cost of living/standard of life and 'countries I wouldn't go' weigh into job decisions; important supported.
